overview.en: The Ragfish is a North Pacific fish in the family Icosteidae.
overview.fr: Le Torchon mou est un poisson du Pacifique Nord de la famille des Icosteidés.

identification.en: It can exceed two metres and has soft muscles and a cartilaginous skeleton.
identification.fr: Il peut dépasser deux mètres et possède une musculature molle et un squelette cartilagineux.

habitat.en: It ranges from Japan to Alaska and California, from the surface to 1420 m.
habitat.fr: Son aire va du Japon à l’Alaska et à la Californie, de la surface jusqu’à 1 420 m.

diet.en: Reported prey include jellyfish, fish, squid and octopuses.
diet.fr: Ses proies signalées comprennent des méduses, des poissons, des calmars et des poulpes.

behavior.en: Adults occur near the bottom; juveniles stay shallower.
behavior.fr: Les adultes vivent près du fond; les jeunes restent en eaux moins profondes.

reproduction.en: Egg and larval records exist, but adult reproduction is poorly documented.
reproduction.fr: Des données sur les œufs et les larves existent, mais la reproduction adulte reste peu documentée.

ecology.en: Larvae have pelvic fins that disappear as adults develop a deeper body.
ecology.fr: Les larves ont des nageoires pelviennes qui disparaissent tandis que le corps adulte s’approfondit.

conservation.en: FishBase lists no global IUCN status. Adult biology remains poorly studied.
conservation.fr: FishBase n’indique pas de statut mondial dans la Liste rouge. La biologie adulte demeure peu étudiée.

facts: FishBase reports North Pacific range, depths to 1,420 m, diet including jellyfish and cephalopods, adults near bottom, juveniles in shallow water, and no global IUCN evaluation.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

title.en: The Ragfish, Icosteus aenigmaticus: a synthesis of historical and recent records — NOAA Marine Fisheries Review
title.fr: Le Ragfish, Icosteus aenigmaticus : synthèse des observations historiques et récentes — NOAA Marine Fisheries Review

facts: Peer-reviewed review describes soft musculature and cartilaginous skeleton, notes sparse adult reproductive data, and calls adult biology poorly studied.

budget.method: Complete referenced bilingual sentences and factual notes.

title.en: Early Life History Description: Icosteus aenigmaticus — NOAA Alaska Fisheries Science Center
title.fr: Description du début du cycle vital d’Icosteus aenigmaticus — NOAA Alaska Fisheries Science Center

facts: NOAA developmental records state that pelvic fins occur in larvae and are lost in adults, as the body changes from elongate to deep.

title.fr: Noms des poissons — American Fisheries Society, noms communs anglais, espagnols et français

facts: The multilingual American Fisheries Society list records the French common name torchon mou for Icosteus aenigmaticus.

uncertainties: Adult reproductive biology and abundance remain poorly known; a missing global IUCN evaluation is not evidence of low risk.
review_note: Compared FishBase range and trophic data with NOAA early-life-history records and a peer-reviewed synthesis; retained uncertainty about adult biology and verified the French name in the AFS multilingual list.
